claims.claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR achieves better performance than DETR with 10 times fewer training epochs.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Deformable DETR can achieve better performance than DETR (especially on small objects) with 10× less training epochs.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The deformable attention module attends to only a small set of key sampling points around a reference point.
claims.evidence_quote_short: the deformable attention module only attends to a small set of key sampling points around a reference point, regardless of the spatial size of the feature maps

claims.claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR has relatively low performance in detecting small objects compared to modern detectors using high-resolution feature maps.
claims.evidence_quote_short: DETR delivers relatively low performance at detecting small objects.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The multi-scale deformable attention module can naturally aggregate multi-scale feature maps without feature pyramid networks.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our proposed multi-scale deformable attention module can naturally aggregate multi-scale feature maps via attention mechanism, without the help of these feature pyramid networks.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Iterative bounding box refinement improves detection performance in Deformable DETR.
claims.evidence_quote_short: We establish a simple and effective iterative bounding box refinement mechanism to improve detection performance.

claims.claim_text_normalized: The two-stage Deformable DETR variant further improves performance over the single-stage version.
claims.evidence_quote_short: The proposed variant of two-stage Deformable DETR can further improve the performance.

claims.claim_text_normalized: Deformable DETR has on par FLOPs with Faster R-CNN + FPN and DETR-DC5 but is 1.6 times faster than DETR-DC5.
claims.evidence_quote_short: Our proposed Deformable DETR has on par FLOPs with Faster R-CNN + FPN and DETR-DC5. But the runtime speed is much faster (1.6×) than DETR-DC5
